help.title: Get in touch
help.courseQuestions: Questions about a course, an exercise or a grade? Ask the instructors of that course. For access or account problems, contact the administrator.

onlineEditor.name: Online code editor
onlineEditor.description: Start coding right away: write, commit and submit your solution in the browser, with nothing to install.

testFeedback.name: Automatic test feedback
testFeedback.description: Learn from every attempt: see which tests your submission passes, which it fails and why.

exam.name: Take an exam
exam.description: Show what you have learned in online exams, with the same editors you practice with.

liveQuiz.name: Live quiz
liveQuiz.description: Check your understanding in live quizzes, together in the lecture or at your own pace.

learningPaths.name: Learning paths
learningPaths.description: Follow a learning path that adapts to your progress, from one competency to the next.

messaging.name: Messages and threads
messaging.description: Ask questions, discuss exercises and learn together with your course in channels and threads.

iris.name: Iris AI tutor
iris.description: Ask Iris whenever you are stuck. Iris already knows your exercise and your latest submission, and guides you to the solution instead of giving it away.

aiFeedback.name: Personalized AI feedback
aiFeedback.description: Request individual AI feedback on your draft before the due date, improve it and submit again.

exerciseGeneration.name: AI-supported exercise generation
exerciseGeneration.description: Generate and refine problem statements, code and quiz questions, and give your students more exercises to learn from.

lectures.name: Lectures
lectures.description: Work through slides, videos and lecture units at your own pace, alongside the exercises that go with them.

project.title: Powered by Artemis
project.description: Artemis is an open-source learning platform, developed by the research group Applied Education Technologies at the Technical University of Munich, and used by universities and schools in several countries.
